body.message:
Hello,

It seems that the internet connection in the apartment is not working properly. The only thing I watch on the TV is Netflix, and every evening I have to wait several minutes (sometimes even longer) before it starts playing. I believe this is due to a poor internet connection.

Even when the series finally starts, the video quality is often very low, which also indicates that the internet speed is not sufficient.

Could you please send someone to check and fix the issue? If it can be resolved remotely by contacting the internet provider, that would be appreciated as well and better.

Thank  You
